name: Lust Theory: Season 1
source: You take control of a guy living with three beautiful women. You live a pretty ordinary life... You go to school, do your chores, study for college, play games, watch TV. And then, the same day starts repeating and repeating, and... repeating. So suddenly your life isn't so ordinary anymore...​
translation: 你控制了一个和三个漂亮女人住在一起的男人。你过着非常平凡的生活……你上学，做家务，学习大学，玩游戏，看电视。然后，同一天开始重复、重复、……重复。突然间你的生活不再那么平凡了……​
